# SHRINEVA

> SHRINEVA is a commercial building for rent or lease at Plot No. D-15, Lalpur Housing Scheme, Stadium Road, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221003, India, opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital and about 100 m from NIFT Varanasi. Three open-plan floors of about 3,500 sq ft gross (about 3,100 sq ft carpet) with flexible tenant layouts can be rented or leased whole or in part. Construction is ongoing; images labelled as renders are indicative.

## Verified facts
- Address: Plot No. D-15, Lalpur Housing Scheme, Stadium Road, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221003, India.
- GPS coordinates: 25.3833895, 82.9786124.
- Leasing phone: +91 81140 80609 (also WhatsApp, https://wa.me/918114080609) and +91 73557 70378. Open Monday to Sunday, 9:30 AM – 7:30 PM IST.
- Location: opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital (under construction, not yet operational) and about 100 m from the NIFT Varanasi campus, on Stadium Road in Bada Lalpur, about 1 km from Ring Road (NH 135B).
- Plot and road: 525 sq m plot with about 50 ft of frontage on a 24 m wide road.
- Floors: three upper floors, each about 3,500 sq ft gross and about 3,100 sq ft carpet. Open-plan commercial floor plates with flexible tenant layouts, offered as open shells to rent or lease whole or in part. Areas are approximate.
- Building: one 8-person passenger lift, a fire exit on every level, Vastu-compliant layout, parking for 12+ cars at ground level.
- Approval: shown on the site as "VDA approved" (Varanasi Development Authority). Sanction details are not published on the site; ask the leasing team.
- Status: construction is ongoing. Images labelled as renders are indicative and the design is subject to change.
- Use of any floor is subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals (municipal, fire and, for food businesses, FSSAI).

## Who can rent or lease here
- Pathology labs, diagnostic centres and clinics
- Banks, NBFCs and insurance branches
- Corporate and IT offices
- Retail showrooms, shops and boutiques
- Restaurants and cafés (subject to municipal, fire and FSSAI approvals)
- Coaching institutes, coworking, fitness and wellness centres

## Frequently asked questions
### Where can I lease commercial space in Bada Lalpur, Varanasi?
SHRINEVA is a commercial building on Stadium Road, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi, opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital and about 100 metres from NIFT Varanasi. Three open floors of about 3,500 sq ft gross can be leased whole or in part, with an 8-person lift, parking for 12+ cars and about 50 ft of frontage on a 24-metre road.

### Where is SHRINEVA located in Varanasi and how wide is the access road?
SHRINEVA is at Plot No. D-15, Lalpur Housing Scheme, Stadium Road, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi 221003, directly opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital and about 100 metres from the NIFT Varanasi campus. It has about 50 ft of frontage on the 24-metre-wide Stadium Road, with quick connectivity to the Varanasi Ring Road.

### What is the carpet area and gross area per floor at SHRINEVA?
Each of the three upper floors has about 3,500 sq ft gross area and about 3,100 sq ft carpet area as open-plan commercial floor plates with flexible tenant layouts. Floors can be leased whole or in part. Areas are approximate and subject to final measurement, and the floors are offered as open shells while construction is ongoing.

### How much car parking and lift capacity does SHRINEVA provide?
SHRINEVA offers parking for 12+ cars at ground level and one 8-person passenger lift serving every floor. Each level has a dedicated fire exit, and the layout is Vastu-compliant. Exact parking and floor arrangements for a tenant are confirmed during the site visit and leasing discussion.

### Which businesses can lease space at SHRINEVA?
SHRINEVA suits pathology labs, diagnostic centres and clinics; banks, NBFCs and insurance branches; corporate and IT offices; retail showrooms and boutiques; restaurants and cafés; and coaching institutes, coworking, fitness and wellness centres. Every use is subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals, including municipal, fire and FSSAI approvals for food businesses.

### How do I book a site visit or contact the SHRINEVA leasing office?
Call +91 81140 80609 or +91 73557 70378, message the leasing team on WhatsApp at +91 81140 80609, or fill in the enquiry form on this page. Site visits and leasing enquiries are handled Monday to Sunday, 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM IST.

### Is the SHRINEVA building complete and ready to move in?
No. Construction at SHRINEVA is ongoing, and the upper floors are offered as open shells that tenants fit out themselves. Images labelled as renders are indicative, while site photos show the current progress. Handover details are agreed with each tenant during leasing.

### Is the Apollo Hospital opposite SHRINEVA already operational?
No. The Apollo Hospital opposite SHRINEVA is upcoming and under construction, so it is not yet operational. The NIFT Varanasi campus is about 100 metres away. SHRINEVA does not claim any footfall figures from either project; please judge the building on its own specifications.

## Notes
- The Apollo Hospital opposite is upcoming and under construction. No footfall, rent or return claim is made for this building.
- Areas are approximate. Use of any floor is subject to floor suitability and statutory approvals.
